desc: Kimber has reached the summit of high capacity 1911 design. The 2K11 is the most capable, out-of-the-box, high-capacity 1911 variant available. From hammer to muzzle, the 2K11 has been built around all the features Kimber enthusiasts requested. The anchor to this performance starts with an enhanced sub-frame shaped for superior magazine fit and control. It comes standard with an accessory rail for optional lights and lasers. The slide is made of stainless steel and features an external extractor for incredible reliability a ramped barrel aids in consistent feeding. The new MJD Designs Kevlar and carbon fiber grip deliver superior strength and echo the slide serrations found on this model. This combines to make the 2K11 a masterpiece of modern firearms design from Kimber.
